window: Superintendent/President - Río Hondo College | Whittier, CA

Dr. Don Moya-Miller serves as Superintendent/President of Rio Hondo College, bringing more than three decades of experience as an educator, scholar, and higher education leader dedicated to expanding opportunity and transforming lives through education. He firmly believes that education changes lives because someone first chooses to believe in another person’s potential.

Dr. Don Moya-Miller serves as Superintendent/President of Rio Hondo College, bringing more than three decades of experience as an educator, scholar, and higher education leader dedicated to expanding opportunity and transforming lives through education. He firmly believes that education changes lives because someone first chooses to believe in another person’s potential.

Dr. Moya-Miller’s commitment to public higher education is rooted in his family’s story. His paternal grandparents immigrated to the United States seeking a better future for their children, instilling values of hard work, perseverance, and service that continue to shape his leadership. Born in Helena, Montana, he spent his early childhood moving throughout the country before his family settled in the San Francisco Bay Area when he was nine years old.

His passion for education began unexpectedly at age ten, when a teacher volunteered to teach Spanish during lunch and recess. That simple act of encouragement sparked a lifelong fascination with languages, cultures, and the connections that bring people together.

Welcome to the Veterans Resource Center

The Veterans Resource Center at Río Hondo College serves as a vital liaison between veterans or their dependents and the Department of Veterans Affairs. We’re here to promote academic and career success for all students who are veterans or dependents of a veteran.
Welcome to the Veterans Resource Center

The Veterans Resource Center at Río Hondo College serves as a vital liaison between veterans or their dependents and the Department of Veterans Affairs. We’re here to promote academic and career success for all students who are veterans or dependents of a veteran.

Turn to us for help navigating the process of claiming education benefits. We can offer you guidance and support in completing all the necessary forms. Río Hondo College diligently forwards all documents related to the application and usage of your benefits to the VA processing center in Muskogee, Oklahoma. This ensures a smooth and efficient process for our veteran community.
